data.current_description: Subscribe to a company. GlobalEntity re-reads its official state on a schedule and delivers a signed webhook (HMAC-SHA256 over the body) on any change to legal status, name, LEI, the GLEIF control chain, and — for Norway — board/roles and registered owners. The signing secret is returned once on creation. The webhookUrl must be a public https:// endpoint.
data.description_suggestion: Creates a new entity-monitoring subscription for a company. GlobalEntity monitors the company's official state and delivers signed webhooks (HMAC-SHA256) when changes occur to legal status, name, LEI, GLEIF control chain, or (for Norway) board/roles and registered owners. Returns the subscription object including a one-time signing secret for webhook verification. The webhookUrl must be a public https:// endpoint. Subscriptions are created with the caller's API key and are not metered.
data.reasoning: Summary is clear and action-oriented. Description lacks explicit mention of the return value (subscription object with signing secret) and side effects (subscription is created and persists). Added clarity about return value and that subscriptions are tied to the API key for better AI agent understanding of state changes.
